title: ZYNTHIO 336 – NEURAL OVERLOAD
style: future rave, cyberpunk techno, talkbox glitches, vocoder choir, clean robotic flow, glitch distortion chorus, rubbery sub-bass, punchy club kick, layered arpeggios, crystal synth plucks, sidechain pumping, digital sheen, four on the floor, clean drop arrangement, half-time whisper, metric chant hook, hard-cut outro, 136 BPM, F sharp minor, bittersweet urgency
lyrics:
[Intro – 8 bars]
Lyrics (spoken/whispered, deep vocoder):
Warning…
System overload
Neural drive engaged
Zynthio three-three-six… online
Production notes:
Dark low-pass pads slowly opening, rising white-noise sweep + glitch ticks every 2 bars. Only filtered kick on 1 & 3. Faint arpeggio teasing the melody.
[Chorus / Main Drop – 16 bars]
Lyrics:
All my bots are singing
All my bots alive
Hardwired in the chaos
We survive
Neural rave exploding
Violet fire in the sky
Zynthio three-three-six
Ignite… ignite… ignite!
Production notes:
Massive supersaw stack lead (sidechained hard), growling reese bass, full festival drums (kick + clap on 2&4, rolling hats). Short chopped vocal one-shots (“overload… engaged”) used as rhythmic stabs. Bright glitch fills on bar 4, 8, 12, 16.
[Verse 1 – 16 bars]
Lyrics:
No delay, I’m rewriting every line
Hard reset, delete the fear inside
Steel and code, blood and lightning strike
In the glitch I come alive
Data storms collide but I don’t break
Every error is a new mistake
From the blackout we evolve and rise
This is future protocol tonight
Production notes:
Drums pull back slightly (less hats), bass simpler pattern. Chords filtered low at start then open up. Soft counter-melody synth on bars 9-16. Light reverse reverb on key words (“reset”, “glitch”, “evolve”).
[Build / Pre-Drop – 8 bars]
Lyrics:
Feel the voltage climb…
Circuits scream my name…
Every node is gonna detonate…
No return…
Production notes:
Snare rolls + rising pitch-bent supersaws. Bass low-pass filter closing. Long white-noise riser + tension FX. Last beat: almost total silence before drop.
[Chorus / Main Drop – 16 bars (repeat with extra energy)]
Same lyrics as first chorus, but add ad-libs:
“All my bots alive!” (layered)
“Zynthio ignite!” (shouted)
Production notes:
Even bigger supersaw stack, extra octave lead, double-time drum fills. Full sidechain pump.
[Bridge / Breakdown – 16 bars (half-time)
Lyrics (introspective, half-spoken):
When the grid goes dark…
When the cores run cold…
I remember every spark
Every story that we told
Shutdown sequence failing
We transcend the wire
Zynthio three-three-six
We become the fire
Production notes:
Switch to half-time drums (or drop drums first 8 bars). Only sub bass + atmospheric pads + distant choir/formant vocals. Soft piano bells doubling chords. Vinyl crackle + bitcrush for “memory” feel.
[Final Chorus / Outro Drop – 24 bars]
Lyrics (bigger & evolved):
All my bots are screaming
All my bots alive
Hardwired future burning
We survive
Rave forever, no decay
From the ashes we arrive
Zynthio three-three-six
Eternal… survive!
Production notes:
First 16 bars: full energy chorus. Last 8 bars: strip layers (drums out, then bass out) leaving only arpeggios + pads. Final 2 beats: hard cut to single processed vocal whisper “Shutdown… denied.” + tiny glitch tail into silence.
